slides.title: The exemption was denied.
slides.subtitle: Someone had to be able to say why.
slides.caption: A Selective Service registration and case management system, built in ninety days as a rehearsal. Synthetic data throughout.
Registering online, where the process used to be paper.
What a registrant sees about their own standing.
The eligibility check runs, and it stops there. It scores the case; it does not close it.
Eligible by the check, and denied anyway by a person, with the reason written on the record underneath.
The queue the staff actually work.
An appeal goes to someone who has not already decided it.
The assistant answers, and shows the passages it drew on. A statement it cannot cite is withheld rather than shown.
Every answer waits for a person, and you cannot review your own question.
The record nobody can quietly edit.
The operational view the paper process never had.
